newsitem.title: USA: Apple South closes Canyon acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Apple South closes Canyon acquisition.

text.p: Apple South Inc said Friday it closed the acquisition of private Canyon Cafes Inc of Dallas, Texas for $36 million.
Apple South said it paid $30.8 million in cash and $5.2 million in stock for the 13 Southwestern restaurants Canyon operates. It added it assumed an additional $7.5 million of Canyon's debt.
The company said Canyon's restaurants average $2.8 million in annual sales each and have operating margins of 18 percent.
Apple South said it now operates a total of 387 restaurants, including 246 Applebee's Neighborhood Grill & Bar restaurants and 80 Don Pablo's Mexican Kitchen restaurants.
